const code = `import json, re, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "tools")
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
base = "7264886e652b9254ea26afc20bac4e3ed64f1e05"
workset = json.loads(Path(".ai/task/repair-w53-20260929/WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
expected = {(x["normalized_path"], x["section"], x["source"], x.get("source_tag")) for x in workset}
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
counts = {}
changed = set()
current_by_key = {}
old_by_key = {}
for path in ("mod-tome.lua", "tome-orcs.lua"):
    old = loader.load_bytes(subprocess.run(["git", "show", f"{base}:{path}"], check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout, logical_path=path).translations
    new = loader.load_path(Path(path), logical_path=path).translations
    assert len(old) == len(new), (path, len(old), len(new))
    n = 0
    for a, b in zip(old, new):
        for field in ("kind", "function_name", "section", "source", "source_tag", "args_order", "special"):
            assert a.get(field) == b.get(field), (path, field, a.get(field), b.get(field))
        key = (path, b.get("section"), b.get("source"), b.get("source_tag"))
        old_by_key[key] = a
        current_by_key[key] = b
        if a.get("target") != b.get("target"):
            changed.add(key)
            n += 1
    counts[path] = {"loaded_records": len(new), "changed_targets": n, "unchanged_records": len(new)-n}
assert changed == expected, {"missing": sorted(expected-changed), "extra": sorted(changed-expected)}
rev = "eed96b47b1f76cf0034b56d64e6d69553456debae545d8c45da95f056e662bf0"
item = next(x for x in workset if x["entry_revision_identity"] == rev)
key = (item["normalized_path"], item["section"], item["source"], item.get("source_tag"))
before = old_by_key[key]["target"]
after = current_by_key[key]["target"]
assert before.count("\\n") == after.count("\\n") == 8
assert [len(x)-len(x.lstrip("\\t")) for x in before.split("\\n")] == [len(x)-len(x.lstrip("\\t")) for x in after.split("\\n")]
assert "有的废墟甚至位于近海沉没的陆地上" in after
assert "目前在学界最流行的说法是，他们强大的魔法毁了他们自己：在某场大规模内乱中，这些魔法被用来对付本族人。" in after
expected_new = [
"但确凿的事实很少，因为人们对这个堪称文明熔炉的古老种族所知甚少。",
"这一领域最博学、最求实的学者是知名探险家和考古学家达沃德·欧卡顿",
"在马基·埃亚尔各地都发现了夏·图尔奇幻建筑的废墟",
"仍远远超出当代最伟大的头脑所能理解的范围",
"至今无人触碰",
"但对他们所留遗物的持续研究与考察，仍在不断带来巨大的价值与启发。"
]
assert all(after.count(s) == 1 for s in expected_new)
print(json.dumps({"runtime":"manifest LuaJIT via LocaleLoader","baseline":base,"total_changed_targets":len(changed),"files":counts,"workset_exact":True,"non_target_fields_unchanged":True,"confirmed_target":{"revision_key":rev,"six_replacements_present":True,"prior_round_sentences_preserved":True,"lf_count":after.count("\\n"),"tab_layout_preserved":True}}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))`;
const quoted = "'" + code.replace(/'/g, "'\\''") + "'";

];

rs.forEach((r,i)=>text(JSON.stringify({validation:i+1,exit_code:r.exit_code,output:r.output})));
